tests.name: GLX context rendering
tests.purpose: Create real OpenGL 3.3 contexts as a trusted compositor. Check varied framebuffer pixels and destroy contexts, windows and colormaps across 32 cycles.

tests.name: Repeated shutdown
tests.purpose: Repeat the unchanged revocation/selection test with the candidate vendor. Preserve any four-second shutdown failure and capture its live process state.

constraints: Keep strict native authentication, original cleanup deadlines and sanitizer assertions. A startup-only success does not prove rendering. Do not install the prototype into system graphics paths.
